headline: Travelers (TRV) Completes Nationwide Synergy Rollout For Life Sciences Liability Coverage
summary: Travelers Companies has completed the nationwide rollout of its Synergy product liability insurance for life sciences companies with its launch in California. The Synergy offering is now available across the United States to life sciences businesses seeking product liability coverage. This expansion marks a new stage for Travelers Companies, which trades on the NYSE under the ticker NYSE:TRV, in targeting specialized insurance segments.
